summary: A change record's `contract` may also name a published package's TypeScript API contract, `@scope/name/MAJOR`, where MAJOR may be 0. Every key that matched before still matches. Schema version 1.1.0.
why: Package contracts are keyed by the npm package name and its major version (flyingrobots/geordi#219). The gate cannot tell whether a changed pattern widens or narrows, so it reports the change as unknown and treats it as breaking; this pattern only widens.
